mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_sla_priority (tenant_id, policy_id, priority_code, priority_name, first_response_minutes, resolution_minutes, sort_no, deleted, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.policyId}, #{entity.priorityCode}, #{entity.priorityName}, #{entity.firstResponseMinutes}, #{entity.resolutionMinutes}, #{entity.sortNo}, #{entity.deleted}, #{entity.createBy}, #{entity.createTime}, #{entity.updateBy}, #{entity.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE priority_code = VALUES(priority_code), priority_name = VALUES(priority_name), first_response_minutes = VALUES(first_response_minutes), resolution_minutes = VALUES(resolution_minutes), sort_no = VALUES(sort_no), deleted = VALUES(deleted), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
